name: Cutroom
summary: A video editor where you and an AI assistant edit the same storyboard file

shot.alt: Cutroom: a transition library on the left, the video preview, effect settings, and a timeline with lanes for overlays, effects, camera moves, captions, voice-over and sound effects

hook: A video editor that keeps each video as one JSON file, so you on the timeline and an AI assistant in the chat panel can edit the same cut.

notes: A filmstrip timeline with lanes for every overlay, effect, camera move, voice line and sound. One storyboard gives a narrated cut and a beat-synced music cut, each in 16:9 and 9:16.
182 effects, 58 sound effects, and free offline voice-over in 100 Chinese and 3 English voices.
Ctrl+click a spot in the preview and tell the assistant what to change. It also records websites and voices the narration, on a Claude, ChatGPT or Google subscription or any OpenAI-compatible model.

pages.title: How it works
notes: Whichever model answers, it may run only the editor’s own CLI on the open project: no file edits, no other programs.
Every save, from the UI or the CLI, names the version it started from. If the file changed in between, the save is refused and the current file comes back, so neither side overwrites the other.
The preview is a Remotion Player running the composition the renderer uses. A test renders 13 frames both ways and needs at least 50 dB PSNR; a different frame, as a control, must fall below it.
pages.caption: One file, two editors, and one composition for both preview and export.

blurb: open-source video editor where you and an AI assistant edit the same storyboard file
